jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit/reference-guided construction of a modular pixel-art baseball BODY LAYER.
INPUT1 is the already approved HEADLESS NORMAL BODY sheet, four poses. Match its EXACT art style, pixel-cluster scale, green/white uniform, peach skin, dark shoes and four-pose sequence. INPUT2 is the original six-body-type design; use ONLY the specified body type's torso and limb proportions as body-shape reference. The HEADS in input2 are NOT to be drawn.
Output exactly FOUR HEADLESS BODIES in one horizontal row on a1774x887 transparent canvas. Same positions/pivot areas as input1: first body centered x220, running body neckaround x648, batting body neckaround x1020, bowed body neckaround x1540. Feet on the same invisible ground y750. Keep the bat entirely inside canvas and separate from adjacent bodies.
Poses LEFT toRIGHT: 1 front neutral standing empty hands; 2 running towardright three-quarter with one foot pushing off and opposite knee up, arms alternating; 3 batting contact towardright with BOTH hands on ONE wooden bat, feet planted; 4 slight forwardbow towardright, arms hanging by thighs, body leaned forward. No heads, no faces, no ears, no caps/hair, no text/logos/labels. Preserve a tiny flat peach NECK STUB and whitecollar at each neck connection, same approx42px neck width as input1, so the SAME head can attach later.
All four bodies must have the same bodytype anatomy and lengths; pose bending changes their visible height, not their anatomy. Make the torso+limb length difference in all four poses, don't just change frontstanding. Use hard square pixelclusters with limited flat colors. No soft contours, no new pixel scale, no gradients, no anatomical muscle detail. Solid trained athlete, not realistic adult anatomy or baby.
TRUE transparent alpha0 background, opaque sprite pixels, no mist, shadows, ground, checkerboard, outlines around empty regions. Leave the entire head area transparent. Do not draw a complete figure or new head.
SPECIFIC BODY TYPE TO MAKE: SECOND body from input2. Compact solid muscular HEAVYWEIGHT. About28% wider torso/arms than normal, chest deep and square, waist substantial but flat, thick arms and thighs/calves. Do NOT create a protruding round belly, balloon hips, fat tummy, or obese shape. Keep waist thicker than the broad-shoulder type. Slightly taller than normal: standing necktop aroundy360 instead ofnormal383, feet750. Increase body neck-to-sole length about6%, not huge. Existing head will be same exact size.
